description: Behavioral fingerprint of a healthy professional services firm operating on WAANDA. Used as the reference profile when computing EnterpriseDNA for new PS deployments.
notes: approvalSpeed starts MODERATE for most PS firms — L3 approvals average 4–8 hours. After 90 days on WAANDA, firms with healthy COIG typically shift to FAST (< 2h median). Risk tolerance BALANCED reflects that PS firms can't absorb large project delays but also can't be so conservative that they turn down good opportunities.
